name: Atlas HO Code 83
description: Atlas HO scale Code 83 nickel-silver sectional and flex track. Code 83 refers to rail height of 0.083 in. Includes Snap-Track sectional curves (18" and 22" radius), 9" and 6" straights, fitter pieces in 1/4" through 3" lengths, Super-Flex flex track, Customline turnouts (#4, #6, #8, Y, three-way), 19 and 25 degree crossings, rerailers, and bumpers. Geometry shared with Atlas Code 100; only the rail height differs. SKUs and descriptions follow Atlas catalog conventions; values flagged null require dealer/manufacturer re-check before shipping.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/atlas-ho-code-83.md for per-system caveats.
